segmentation.method: alpha128 projection bands and midpoint separators

prompt:
Precise direct edit of these 4 approved ADULT FEMALE pixel-art characters. Output ONE ROW of exactly 4 complete character sprites, identical left-to-right identity order. Reference is authority for EACH character's skin, eyes, species face, ears, hair/fur/scales, horns, markings, clothing, proportions, genuine attached tail. Keep each exact identity without palette transfer or male-body substitution. Keep BACK-facing view, looking away from camera with no faces visible throughout.
On EVERY sprite REMOVE the ENTIRE SCREEN-RIGHT ARM at shoulder, including hand. Leave the SCREEN-LEFT arm AND hand fully intact. Screen coordinates are literal: absent on image right, present on image left. Do not mirror or reverse directions.
Keep both complete legs and feet. ONLY ONE ARM absent. Remaining arm must be visible and attached. Keep a small RED pixel cut cap on the removed side. No ghost limb strips, hand/foot fragments, splatter or realistic injury detail. Do not mistake any tail or long hair for a limb; retain it completely. Do not add new markings on legs, clothing or torso to replace markings removed with the limb. Preserve original dark fitted top/shorts and chunky pixel shading. Full remaining bodies, generous transparent gutters, no clipping. Transparent alpha with NO glow, haze, floor, shadows, labels, text or detached pieces. ONE row, 4 sprites total.
method: native corrective complete pose; layout extraction only
reviewNote: Native complete corrective pose visually checked for specified screen-side absence, intact other limbs and attached features.
